messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-05-04, Team Boreal still owns the catalog service. [valid 2026-05-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-04]
- As of 2025-06-16, Team Boreal owns the catalog service, having taken it over from Team Dune. [valid 2025-06-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-16-catalog]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-20, Team Dune owns the catalog service. [valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-06-16; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-catalog]
    earlier: Team Cinder owns the catalog service. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from Team Boreal. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23; recorded by handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- As of 2026-05-26, the billing service is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Boreal. [valid 2026-05-26 to now; recorded by handover/2026-05-26-billing-api]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-17, the billing service lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-17 to 2026-05-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2025-11-20, the event bus is owned by Team Boreal, which took it over from Team Cinder. [valid 2025-11-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-20-event-bus]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-26, the event bus is owned by Team Cinder, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-08-26 to 2025-11-20; recorded by handover/2025-08-26-event-bus]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-03, the event bus is owned by Team Atlas. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-08-26; recorded by handover/2025-04-03-event-bus]
    earlier: The event bus is owned by Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- On 2025-05-08, Team Boreal flagged that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, noting the catalog service is not their service. [valid 2025-05-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-08]
- As of 2025-12-23, the pager for the auth gateway rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
- As of 2025-12-08, the indexer is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Cinder. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer lives with Team Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-08; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- As of 2025-11-13, the ledger is owned by the Ember team, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-13-ledger]
    earlier: The ledger lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of January 2025, the Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus. [valid 2025-01-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-07]
- As of 2026-03-12, for anything Boreal-related, page Lena. [preference; valid 2026-03-12 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-12]
- As of 2026-02-24, the feature-flags service belongs to Team Cinder, which took it over from Team Boreal. [valid 2026-02-24 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-24-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-29, the feature-flags service belongs to Team Boreal, which took it over from Team Cinder. [valid 2025-09-29 to 2026-02-24; recorded by handover/2025-09-29-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-09, the feature-flags service belongs to Team Cinder, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-07-09 to 2025-09-29; recorded by handover/2025-07-09-feature-flags]
    earlier: The feature-flags service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-07-09; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-28-webhooks]
- On 2025-09-08, Team Boreal noticed that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- As of 2026-02-19, Marcus Oyelaran has transferred from Team Boreal to Team Atlas. [valid 2026-02-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-19]

Question: Which team owned the catalog before Boreal took it over?

message.reasoning: The question asks which team owned the catalog before Boreal took it over. Memory: "As of 2025-06-16, Team Boreal owns the catalog service, having taken it over from Team Dune." So Team Dune.
